note: Authoritative inventory of every environment variable the code reads. Values live in Doppler (logloads project) and Vercel; never commit real values. `status` reflects repo truth and must be provider-verified before cutover.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.purpose: Canonical origin for absolute URLs, OG metadata, Stripe return URLs.
variables.absent_behavior: falls back to http://localhost:3002; breaks absolute links/redirects in prod

variables.name: LOGLOADS_SESSION_SECRET
variables.purpose: HMAC key signing the ll_session cookie.
variables.absent_behavior: THROWS at startup in production (fail-closed by design)

variables.name: LOGLOADS_STATE_FILE
variables.purpose: Path to the non-production JSON fallback snapshot.
variables.status: local development only; never production authority
variables.absent_behavior: defaults to <cwd>/.data/logloads-state.json outside production

variables.name: LOGLOADS_ALLOW_STATE_BOOTSTRAP
variables.purpose: One-time permission to create an intentionally absent canonical operating_state row.
variables.status: MUST be unset in established production
variables.absent_behavior: production fails closed when the canonical row is absent

variables.name: LOGLOADS_ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN
variables.purpose: Enables the credential-free email dev sign-in.
variables.absent_behavior: dev login disabled in production (correct)

variables.name: LOGLOADS_RATE_LIMIT_HMAC_SECRET
variables.purpose: Preferred dedicated high-entropy key for HMAC-SHA-256 pseudonymization of rate-limit identifiers.
variables.status: RECOMMENDED; founder may generate and place it without adding a provider
variables.absent_behavior: uses the required server-only Supabase service-role key as HMAC key material; rotating the effective key resets active buckets

variables.name: LOGLOADS_RATE_LIMIT_KEY_PREFIX
variables.purpose: Namespace separating LogLoads rate-limit keys and deployment environments.
variables.status: defaults to logloads:rate-limit; use environment-specific value if sharing an account
variables.absent_behavior: uses the safe application default

variables.name: LOGLOADS_RATE_LIMIT_TEST_MODE
variables.purpose: Allows only a non-Vercel, loopback-Supabase Playwright server to bypass request limits when dev login is also enabled.
variables.status: MUST be unset in hosted Preview and Production
variables.absent_behavior: production requires the external shared store (correct)

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.purpose: Client Clerk key; mounts ClerkProvider and enables real auth.
variables.absent_behavior: production auth unavailable

variables.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: Server Clerk key; verifies sessions server-side.
variables.absent_behavior: Clerk session resolution disabled

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Project REST URL for canonical operating state and the shared atomic rate-limit RPC.
variables.status: https://fdzohbiiyzgvjzfsjyxo.supabase.co (live project; runtime lane must be verified)
variables.absent_behavior: production canonical-state and abuse-control access fail closed

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.purpose: Server-only runtime credential for operating_state and the service-role-only rate-limit RPC.
variables.status: required; value intentionally not represented in repo
variables.absent_behavior: production canonical-state and abuse-control access fail closed

variables.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: Server Stripe key; enables real checkout and billing portal.
variables.absent_behavior: billing surfaces show honest 'activation pending'; no checkout

variables.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.purpose: Verifies Stripe webhook signatures at /api/billing/webhook.
variables.absent_behavior: webhook returns 503; subscription state never updates from Stripe

variables.name: STRIPE_PRICE_DISPATCH
variables.purpose: Verified Stripe recurring Price id for Dispatch Pro at exactly $499/month.
variables.absent_behavior: checkout fails closed; no inline or alternate amount can be charged

variables.name: LOGLOADS_CLOUDINARY_TENANCY
variables.purpose: Explicit operator attestation that the three CLOUDINARY_* values resolve to a dedicated LogLoads tenant; only the exact value `dedicated` activates media.
variables.status: MUST remain unset until an accountable operator verifies dedicated LogLoads ownership and production wiring
variables.absent_behavior: overall health remains engine-driven, integrations.media=false, and all media signing, verification, and delivery fail closed with a retryable unavailable response

variables.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
variables.purpose: Cloudinary account namespace for signed authenticated driver media (profile, truck, trailer) and trip-document proof.
variables.status: A dated 2026-07-16 provider round trip exists, but production remains intentionally inactive until the value is replaced with dedicated LogLoads wiring and the tenancy marker is operator-attested.
variables.absent_behavior: integrations.media=false and all media operations fail closed before a provider call

variables.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Server-side API identity used to sign direct uploads and authenticated delivery.
variables.status: Must belong to the independently verified dedicated LogLoads tenant; it does not activate media without the exact tenancy marker and complete credentials.
variables.absent_behavior: integrations.media=false and all media operations fail closed before a provider call

variables.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
variables.purpose: Server-only secret used to sign uploads, verify stored assets, and sign private delivery.
variables.status: Must belong to the independently verified dedicated LogLoads tenant; it does not activate media without the exact tenancy marker and complete credentials.
variables.absent_behavior: integrations.media=false and all media operations fail closed before a provider call

variables.name: RESEND_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Enables outbound email (contact inquiries, future operating emails).
variables.status: deferred until logloads.com sending is verified on the current plan
variables.absent_behavior: email delivery skipped; in-app notification remains the record (no false success)

variables.name: RESEND_FROM
variables.purpose: Primary scoped From identity for outbound LogLoads email.
variables.status: configured as the verified LogLoads notifications sender
variables.absent_behavior: falls back to LOGLOADS_EMAIL_FROM, then the Resend onboarding sender

variables.name: RESEND_REPLY_TO
variables.purpose: Primary monitored reply identity for outbound product email.
variables.absent_behavior: falls back to SUPPORT_EMAIL, LOGLOADS_EMAIL_REPLY_TO, then support@logloads.com

variables.name: SUPPORT_EMAIL
variables.purpose: Shared support-address fallback used for Reply-To.
variables.absent_behavior: falls back to LOGLOADS_EMAIL_REPLY_TO, then support@logloads.com

variables.name: LOGLOADS_EMAIL_FROM
variables.purpose: Compatibility fallback for the outbound From identity.
variables.absent_behavior: RESEND_FROM remains authoritative

variables.name: LOGLOADS_EMAIL_REPLY_TO
variables.purpose: Compatibility fallback for the monitored reply identity.
variables.absent_behavior: RESEND_REPLY_TO and SUPPORT_EMAIL remain authoritative

variables.name: LOGLOADS_CONTACT_EMAIL
variables.purpose: Recipient for contact-form inquiries.
variables.absent_behavior: routes to the existing LogLoads support mailbox

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY
variables.purpose: Project ingestion key; activates client + server analytics.
variables.absent_behavior: analytics inert (no init, no network)

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST
variables.purpose: Ingestion host.
variables.absent_behavior: US cloud default

variables.name: SENTRY_DSN
variables.purpose: Activates server error capture via instrumentation.ts.
variables.absent_behavior: Sentry never imported/initialized; app healthy without it

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Activates Mapbox basemap; otherwise keyless MapLibre/Carto.
variables.absent_behavior: map renders real geography via keyless MapLibre fallback

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.purpose: Set by the runtime; 'production' in the container.
variables.absent_behavior: defaults to development

variables.name: NEXT_RUNTIME
variables.purpose: Set by Next.js per runtime; gates Sentry node init.
variables.absent_behavior: n/a

variables.name: VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
variables.purpose: Build provenance surfaced by /api/health.
variables.absent_behavior: health reports gitCommit 'unknown'

variables.name: GITHUB_SHA
variables.purpose: Build provenance fallback for /api/health.
variables.absent_behavior: health reports gitCommit 'unknown'

variables.name: CI
variables.purpose: Toggles Playwright forbidOnly/retries and server reuse.
variables.absent_behavior: local test defaults

unused_in_code_remove_or_ignore: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (present in .env.example but NOT read — checkout uses Stripe hosted Checkout, no client Stripe.js)
DATABASE_URL / SUPABASE_ANON_KEY / SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF (schema/tooling reference only; runtime does not read them)
